description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeDistributionByLocationModel, which is part of the OrangeHRM dashboard API. The class models employee distribution data by location and uses traits for serialization. It implements normalization functionality and constructs its data from a LocationEmployeeCount DTO, specifying how the data fields map for API serialization.
